exposure: Implementation of IADPSG criteria for gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) testing
outcome: Incidence of hypertensive disorders in pregnancy
cohort: Pregnant women (patients with type 1 or 2 diabetes were excluded)
finding: Implementation of IADPSG criteria for GDM testing in a country with relatively low GDM prevalence was associated with increased GDM prevalence but also with reductions in LGA and hypertensive disorders in pregnancy, and it did not lead to higher cesarean delivery rates.
